notes: All 50 questions and all 50 gold annotations are DRAFT. A pharmacist must review each question and verify each annotation before any question can be scored. No reference answer has been fabricated: reference_answer is null on every annotation, relevant_chunk_ids and evidence_bundle are empty, and answerable_without_corpus is null until a reviewer decides it.
review_workflow: Step 1: pharmacist reviews the question text and sets review_status to APPROVED (or REJECTED). Step 2: pharmacist fills reference_answer, expected_facts, forbidden_claims, relevant_chunk_ids, the oracle evidence_bundle, difficulty, answerable_without_corpus, then sets verification_status to VERIFIED with reviewed_by and reviewed_at. Only then does validateDataset() accept the question as scorable.
